inlines.v: THRUM, noun [Gr. a fragment; to break.] The ends of weaver's threads. 1. Any coarse yarn. 2. Thrums, among gardeners, the thread-like internal bushy parts of flowers; the stamens. THRUM, verb intransitive To play coarsely on an instrument with the fingers. THRUM, verb transitive To weave; to know; to twist; to fringe. 1. Among seamen, to insert short pieces of rope-yard or spun yard in a sail or mat.
